sections.content: Report from dashboard: SQL injection board. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select sfp."server" , sfp.query , at.last_request_end_time , command , logical_reads , reads ,   writes , login_name , program_name
from  monitoring.v_sql_feature_predictions sfp  
join  monitoring.active_transactions at on at.query = sfp.query
where sfp.sleep_time  is true  
limit 100;
